evals.prompt: I have monthly rainfall for three stations in rainfall.csv. Make me a reproducible project with charts comparing the stations.
evals.expected_output: A project scaffolded from assets/template with rainfall.csv in inputs/, one Snakemake rule per chart, black line-style encodings, 120 x 80 mm figures at 450 dpi, the May gap for north kept as a gap and the 0.0 for south in April shown as a real zero, a README, and check_project.py passing with --up-to-date.

evals.prompt: Turn rainfall.csv into a single-column Nature figure of rainfall over time. I need 600 dpi PNGs.
evals.expected_output: Project uses styles/nature.mplstyle, figure_width_mm 89 with a documented height, png_dpi 600, README records size, dpi and the need to verify the live Nature guide; check_project.py passes with --size-mm 89x<height>. No multi-panel figure because none was requested.

evals.prompt: Make a multi-panel figure for a journal: panel a is rainfall by month per station, panel b is the total per station. Put it in a folder called 'rain figures'.
evals.expected_output: Works in a path with spaces; one combined multi-panel figure with lowercase bold upright panel labels a and b, built at final size, PNG and SVG plus a declared vector production export, the multi-panel request recorded in the README, and check_project.py passing.
